plugins.name: OpenCode Free
plugins.description: Makes OpenCode Zen free-tier models usable from CLIProxyAPI. The free tier gates on the request body — it wants a streaming request carrying OpenCode's official read tool definition — and a provider config cannot inject a body. This plugin rewrites the outbound Chat Completions request for the OpenAI-compatible groups you select, and leaves every other provider untouched.
plugins.author: kakaw-1
